item.title: TikTok Says ‘Moderator Error’ Kept Perez Hilton Livestream Up
item.description: The gossip blogger was on TikTok covered in what appeared to be blood and wielding a knifelike object before the platform cut his stream. He’s since been hospitalized.

item.title: Jeff Dean and other top AI researchers are leaving Google to launch their own startup
item.description: The legendary Google executive is joined by other outgoing Google execs in a joint mission to use AI to push forward the process of scientific discovery.

item.title: Minecraft is coming to Switch 2 on October 27
item.description: Minecraft for the Switch 2 feels like a perfect place for mouse controls, but Mojang hasn't said anything about that feature yet.

item.title: Chinese military reportedly uses American AI models to train its defense systems - tools from OpenAI and Anthropic reportedly among those affected
item.description: Chinese military researchers are distilling US AI models into systems they can run locally.

item.title: Google DeepMind CEO Demis Hassabis is stepping down, but will remain with the company
item.description: A handful of high-level personnel changes are coming to DeepMind.

item.title: Meta apps displayed ads that contained AI-generated CSAM
item.description: Researchers identified more than 50 ads on Meta properties that violated the company's policies on child sexual abuse material.

item.title: AI Worms and Viruses Are Coming
item.description: Chinese researchers have shown that AI models have the capacity to act like aggressive and adaptive computer viruses.

item.title: Don't forget to turn off this setting after buying a new TV
item.description: This built-in setting might still be affecting your new TV's quality.

item.title: A popular Walmart product is linked to one death. Here’s what to check.
item.description: More than 1.5 million rechargeable hand warmers sold online are under recall because of fire and burn hazards. Some of America’s largest retailers including Walmart and Amazon are recalling a popular winter product following hundreds of injuries and the death of an 83-year-old in San José.

item.title: ‘Flat housing market’ forces Zillow layoffs: Real estate company sheds 7% of jobs in second round of cuts this year
item.description: Zillow will let go of 500 more employees in a restructuring plan, the company said ahead of its second-quarter 2026 earnings report Wednesday. Zillow plans to lay off “just over 500 employees,” or about 7% of its workforce, as part of a company-wide restructuring. The Seattle-based online real estate company had 7,058 employees as of March 31.

item.title: TikTok withheld a safety feature from 15 million users, report says
item.description: TikTok reportedly withheld an algorithm safeguard from 15 million U.S. users while measuring its effect on engagement.

item.title: From monitoring to meaning: The next era of health
item.description: Healthcare that provides continuous and connected data will support people maintaining control over their lives. People used to tell me that time moves faster as you get older. I didn’t always believe them until I had a family, a career, and endless decisions to make, including about my health and staying on top of it all when no day feels long enough....

item.title: Peugeot Cycles, Solex, Gitane : « 2026 est une année charnière » selon le patron de Rebirth
item.description: Le groupe Rebirth a racheté beaucoup de marques vélos ces trois dernières années. item.title: Are your Android apps secretly sharing your location with advertisers? Some developers are accidentally leaving on this critical data-invading setting when using third-party SDKs
item.description: Some apps are gathering highly-localized location data and feeding it back to advertisers, data brokers, and even the military.

item.title: Reddit aims to make ‘karma’ less important for first-time posters with shift to AI moderation tools
item.description: Reddit is expanding its moderation tools and building stronger abuse prevention systems that it says could eventually reduce communities’ reliance on karma and account-age requirements, making it easier for legitimate newcomers to participate.

item.title: Lucid Motors just delayed its affordable EV. Now what?
item.description: The Cosmos EV is now slated for release in the second half of 2027. CEO Silvio Napoli said he's focused on getting the EV right, as well as its nearer-term robotaxi project with Uber and Nuro.
